metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the word weaver, the drawing, the stair, and twelve pence to the barber.

yesterday: The word on the tables is weaver.
The tooth is out. Three roots. Twelve pence. The line in the book is to the barber.
Alse went up once with salt water. Callers stop at the foot of the stair.
The jaw is still tender. Soft food still.
You gave a king a better speech at his going than the tyrant got. That is the dusk sentence.
